description: This Swift source file defines data structures, utility methods, and an async loader for handling gateway usage data, including usage windows, providers, summaries, and related UI presentation logic.

classes.name: GatewayUsageWindow
classes.description: Represents a usage window with label, used percentage, and optional reset timestamp.

classes.name: GatewayUsageProvider
classes.description: Represents a provider with a list of usage windows, display name, plan, and error info.

classes.name: GatewayUsageSummary
classes.description: Wraps the overall usage summary including update timestamp and list of providers.

classes.name: UsageRow
classes.description: Struct for presenting a usage item with display info, calculation of remaining percentage, and formatting reset time.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Generates a list of UsageRow objects representing the primary usage data for display.

methods.name: detailText
methods.description: Returns descriptive text about the usage, remaining percentage, window label, and reset timing.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Formats the remaining time until reset as a human-readable string.
